objection.status: error reported by an ordinary grader
objection.quote: Inductively, after the first $j+1$ columns have been swept, either one whole $d$-strip remains uncancelled in the odd row, or a cut has occurred in every one of these $j+1$ columns
objection.witness: Proof of lemma (ii) (Liu's lower bound) asserts an inductive dichotomy about uncancelled d-strips versus a cut in every column, with no real justification of the inductive step; the phrase 'two identical copies of all preceding strips plus one parity interchange' is asserted rather than proved, and the counting 'requires at least s+1 cuts' is not derived.
